result.summary: This PR is a small follow-up to #36215 that improves how the asmap (ASN mapping used for IP bucketing) version is surfaced and reused across the codebase. It makes exportasmap reuse AsmapVersion() instead of re-hashing, has init.cpp log the version via NetGroupManager, adds asmap_version to getnetworkinfo, documents how to verify the asmap in use, adds test coverage for addrman re-bucketing behavior, and finally caches the asmap version inside NetGroupManager to avoid repeated hashing.
result.problem: Users and operators verifying which asmap dataset their node is using previously had to dig through logs or manually hash the embedded file; there was also redundant hash computation in code and missing test coverage for addrman re-bucketing when the bucketing method changes.

resolved_concerns: sedited noted re-hashing the asmap on every getnetworkinfo call was wasteful; author added a caching commit to NetGroupManager and got a re-ACK from sedited.

result.card: This PR follows up on #36215 to make the asmap (IP bucketing map) version easier to verify and slightly more efficient: it exposes asmap_version via getnetworkinfo, reuses the cached AsmapVersion() in exportasmap and init logging, adds test coverage for addrman re-bucketing, documents the verification workflow, and caches the version inside NetGroupManager after a reviewer flagged redundant hashing. The change is small, well-scoped, and non-controversial; two members reviewed it, one review comment on caching was implemented by the author and re-ACKed. There is no evidence of external demand for the new RPC field, no bug being fixed, and no security or performance impact beyond a minor caching tidy-up, so it ranks low in every touched category (docs, p2p, rpc, utils) despite being fully ready to merge. It depends on the already-merged #36215 and carries a Needs Backport (32.x) label.
